register: Replay-based attribution on a sampled family: the Tukey-introduction component of each 2023->2024 published boundary move is the median over 16 same-realization pairs of (2024 ward_tie mean cut point with Tukey trimming on minus off), display-rounded at the 2024 published register; on side = stored census of resampled reruns (docsonly membership), off side = fresh recompute identical except pipeline tukey=False (integrity: 2 splits x 16 realizations recomputed with trimming on reproduce the stored Fraction-strings exactly). The residual (published move minus Tukey component) is tested against the stored 2023-based same-year cross-realization null (240 ordered pairs, recomputed exactly and cross-checked against sampled_realizations_2023_2024.json verdicts row by row). Not an attribution on CMS's record: CMS never computed a Tukey-off 2024; the replay family carries the documented family-choice bias, the 16 realizations sample the undocumented GROUPS= family, and the same-realization pairing cancels the group-assignment lottery inside the Tukey estimate but not the family bias. 2023 membership is hypothesis-grade throughout (no outlier-bound check in 2023). Movement register: pre-guardrail where the guardrail bound in either year, published final otherwise (as stored).
